d:
He said he would stay in Brazil and fight. Then, suddenly, he was gone.
Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated presidential candidate and son of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro, has turned up in the United States after a journey that reportedly took him through Argentina and Ecuador. Now in Miami, Bolsonaro has allies and a potential safe haven. But leaving Brazil does not end his legal or political battles. Will he continue his fight from America, or return to face the investigation back home? Palki Sharma tells you.
